CustomField.description: Minimum this count should reach. Anyone below it is served FIRST: within a tier, if any eligible member is under the floor, the pick is restricted to those members until they catch up. This is a priority band, not a gate, so a member below the floor is never blocked by it. Use it to ramp somebody up, for example a new hire who should be fed until they hold a real book rather than only ever getting their even share. Leave blank for no floor. Must be lower than Cap when both are set.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Anyone under this number gets served first until they reach it. Leave blank for no floor.
CustomField.label: Floor
